decisions.reason: Premium customer support is tightly aligned with the firm's agency-focused, round-the-clock service promise, so management is likely to continue it given its strategic fit and ability to explain any weak uptake as temporary.

The version management tool builds directly on the firm's hosting and administration capabilities and had a dedicated page, indicating visible investment and commitment that management is likely to escalate rather than reverse.

Although more distant from the core offer, the data processing contract tool had its own page and can be justified as a compliance-oriented complement for hosting clients, making management inclined to persist with it after investing and publicly backing it.

Scalable hosting for agencies sits at the center of the firm's stated direction and was promoted on the home page, so the combination of strong strategic fit and public commitment makes continued support very likely.
